# Political World — AI/LLM entry
Project: Political World for WorldBox
Core: 1.7.0 public beta candidate
Public API: PoliticalWorldAPI 1.6.0
Public namespace: Lous12.PoliticalWorld

Read first:
- /AI_START_HERE.md
- /ARCHITECTURE.md
- /API_VERSIONING.md

Rules for addons:
- Use only public PoliticalWorldAPI.
- Do not depend on Main, ScenarioBridge, reflection, or internal modules.
- Use stable namespaced IDs.
- Check IsCompatible and HasCapability.
- Prefer Event Bus and Rare Political Event Registry over permanent polling.
- Use addon-private state for private data.
